observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the left margin and the locators «p. 143.» (L1) and «p. 144.» (L25) in the right margin.
body L5: «nychthemerōn» is printed with a macron over the last o.
body L7: a speck stands between «coniunctionis,» and «conversas»; it is not a sign.
body L11, L12: «ar–Raqqah» is divided at its dash, and the dash is printed both at the end of L11 and at the beginning of L12.
body L9: the final h of «ar–Raqqah» is printed broken.
body L27, L39: the o of «noctis» and of «quorum» is printed thin, its sides as broken strokes.
body L31: a speck stands over the e of «Lunae,»; it is not an accent.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
